chunks: The grand Shaikh al-Mufid Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man, may Allah continue to bless him with His protection and beneficence, said on this day: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Hammad, from Abu Jamilah, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad al-Baqir, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said:

Indeed, the angel appointed over the servant (of Allah) records his deeds in his scroll. So register a good deed at its beginning and at its end, and Allah will forgive you what transpires in between.

key_terms.أملوا: Register/dictate — an imperative urging believers to ensure good deeds are recorded
key_terms.الملك الموكل: The appointed angel — refers to the recording angels (Kiraman Katibin) who document every deed
key_terms.صحيفته: His scroll/record — the book of deeds kept for each individual
key_terms.يغفر: He will forgive — divine pardon for the sins between the good deeds

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the angel who records deeds?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS), through Imam al-Baqir (AS), taught that the angel assigned to each person records all their deeds. He advised believers to ensure that their record begins and ends with good deeds, promising that God would then forgive the sins committed in between. This teaching was delivered in the scholarly gathering (majlis) of Shaikh al-Mufid in Baghdad, emphasizing the importance of consistently maintaining good conduct, particularly at the start and end of one's daily activities.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. The grand Shaikh al-Mufid Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu’man, may Allah continue to bless him with His protection and beneficence today said: Abul Hasan Ahmed ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al Saffar, from Ahmed ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Hammad, from Abu Jamilah, from Jabir ibn Yazeed that Abu Ja’far Muhammad al-Baqir, peace be upon him, reported from his father that:

"Surely, the Angel appointed to the servant (of Allah) records (everything) in his books of deeds. So, register a good deed at its beginning and at its end, (so that) Allah may forgive you that which transpires in between."
